proxy_fit_report.what: Inferred high-resolution proxy cat scored through the locked camera with the same catlib.metrics functions used for the budget variants. NOT a deliverable mesh.

camera.method: joint CMA-ES fit of camera (look_at + azimuth/elevation/distance) and the parametric proxy cat to reference/derived/mask.png + landmarks.json (scripts/fit_camera_proxy.py); gauge: withers 0.25 m; 85 mm, roll 0 fixed

priors.torso_smooth: second differences of torso top/bottom/half-width over stations 1-7 (8 mm scale)
priors.torso_width_ratio: torso width (2*half-width) 55-75 % of its height, stations 1-6
priors.withers_top: withers gauge: torso top at station 6 (above the shoulder joints) fixed at 0.25 m; chest station 7 not above it, station 5 at most 15 mm above it; back/rump free
priors.body_length: chest-to-rump length incl. end caps 0.40-0.50 m
priors.head_depth: head back-of-skull to muzzle tip 8.5-11 cm
priors.stance_front/hind: paw y separation 8-11 cm; paw pair centred on y=0
priors.paw_centroid_x: x origin gauge: mean paw x near 0
priors.limb_symmetry: left/right segment lengths and top-joint heights equal (radii shared exactly)
priors.leg_tops_in_torso: shoulder/hip joints inside the torso section
priors.joint_order: elbow behind shoulder/wrist, stifle in front of hip/hock, hock 3.5-9 cm high
priors.tail_smooth: tail control polygon turns <= 45 deg per joint, segments >= 3.5 cm (no hooks)
priors.rump_round: rear torso station height >= 75 % and half-width >= 80 % of the next station
priors.tail_on_rump: tail base on the rear of the torso, upper half
priors.tail_attached: tail base centre inside the torso rear dome / section (<= 0.85 normalised radius)
priors.ear_symmetry: ear tips mirror-symmetric in the head frame (weak)
priors.neck_anchor/neck_length: neck anchored in the front torso, head within 6-15 cm of it
priors.head_y: head origin near the sagittal plane
priors.neck_width: neck base radius <= chest half-width at the anchor; neck top <= 0.85 head half-width
priors.fixed_by_construction: paw soles on z=0, body sagittal plane y=0, left/right leg radii shared, roll 0, 85 mm, principal point centred

assumptions: 85 mm focal length on a 36 mm sensor (decision, not measured); roll 0; principal point centred
scale gauge: withers (torso top above the shoulder joints) = 0.25 m
body sagittal plane y = 0, nose +X, paw soles flat on z = 0
left/right legs share thickness parameters exactly; left/right segment lengths tied by prior
inferred_not_observed: everything on the cat's left side (left flank, far side of head, inner surfaces of the left ear)
torso width / cross-section (only height and outline are observed): width set by the 55-75 % of height prior and the superellipse exponent
belly underside and chest depth seen from below
head depth (back-of-skull to muzzle) and skull/cheek widths beyond the visible face outline
stance width (paw y) of all four legs: 8-11 cm prior; lateral positions of hips/shoulders
left-leg thicknesses (copied from the right legs); far hind leg (HL) upper part hidden by the belly
ear thickness (3-4.5 mm semi-axis, bounded), ear cup shape (pinnae are solid flattened cones)
tail lateral (y) deviation: kept near the sagittal plane by prior
top-of-back shape between the observed outline points (smoothness prior)
smooth-union fillets between parts (blend radii in build_report.json)

notes: Official metrics: Blender silhouette render through the shared camera (CONTRACT §7).
novel_view_iou_vs_proxy and chamfer_mm_vs_proxy compare against inferred geometry, not ground truth.
delta = final - initial; for IoU higher is better, for *_px / chamfer lower is better.
